title: Enforcement powers.
bodyText: All law enforcement officers and personnel authorized to carry out the provisions of this chapter may issue citations for violations of this chapter or any of the rules adopted hereunder.
bodyHtml: [§339-9]  Enforcement powers.  All law enforcement officers and personnel authorized to carry out the provisions of this chapter may issue citations for violations of this chapter or any of the rules adopted hereunder. [L Sp 1977 1st, c 2, pt of §2]
